objective: Turn game-derived diegetic interface research into a reality-anchored CARE/HOUSE interaction pattern without adding a dashboard, health score, new state owner or actuation authority.
theory: AGENCY / CARE / LIGHTCONE orientation retained: CARE SCOPE != COMPETENCE != AUTHORITY.
Wider scope is only useful when local resolution and lawful efficacy are preserved.
Selected local condition never becomes a global medical/safety score.
donors: Dead Space: world/object remains visible; interface attaches to locus
Spiritfarer: care becomes a concrete relational action where lawful

delta.care: selected body-plan locus → OBSERVE / PRIOR / COURSE; map remains visible; prior evidence reuses ghost projection
delta.house: selected room → CARE / BODY / DAYLINE; spatial substrate remains visible; existing handoffs retain authority
delta.shared_runtime: NONE; invariant repeated across two unequal host-local implementations only

proof_contract: CARE phone browser probe must click a real body-plan region and verify map visibility, aperture containment, exactly three actions, OBSERVE focus and COURSE transition.
HOUSE phone browser probe must verify selected room visibility, aperture containment, exactly three actions and native CARE transition.
Game-donor transfer registry must resolve both recipient routes and retain no-new-sovereign-app law.

authority.care_locus: derived UI only; existing CARE state/operations own effects
authority.house_locus: derived UI only; existing HOUSE projection/context bridges own effects

privacy: No personal health/care case, household episode, sensor telemetry or private message content is committed. Public repo contains mechanism/code/contracts only.
falsifier: Remove the locus aperture if it obscures the represented substrate, creates score/urgency semantics, duplicates host navigation without reducing translation, grows beyond three immediate actions, or becomes a second state owner.
next: If CARE and HOUSE pass browser proof, retain host-local implementations. BODY/FIT becomes the next unequal candidate only if a locus-attached FIT/SENSE/PATINA move reduces translation without adding health scoring.
